The ambience was good visually. Its good if u have an event during the daylight. Because in the evening u will find a lot of mosquitoes biting u. Good for conducting magic shows, skits, drama, dance, etc. of 2 - 2.5
hours duration to ensure that u wind up before its dark, in order to avoid the mosquito bites. Otherwise be prepared to carry mosquito repellents/sprays with u. And if u want to conduct a musical or singing event,  u need to arrange an impeccable sound system, mic settings, etc. managed by a good sound manager who is proactive and doesn't need to be told everything because acoustics are very important when one is singing in an open arena like an amphitheater. I personally had a bad experience where the sound arrangements, mic settings were not up to the mark, there was no proper feedback, a buzzing sound was coming from the mic while singing, the sound manager was pathetic. So just ensure to get all these things right if u are arranging a musical event.

However, the venue itself left a bit to be desired. There was no staff at the entrance when we arrived, and we had to wait around 15 minutes before someone showed up. The space is quite small and cramped, with very little legroom, which made sitting for a long time a bit uncomfortable.

Overall, a great show but the management and seating experience could definitely be better.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Open mic by Kasa Kai Mumbai offers a welcoming and inclusive space for aspiring artists to share their talents with a supportive audience. The events are well-organized and attract a diverse range of performers. It is overall an entertaining and engaging experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking to showcase their creativity.
Cheers!🥂

featured_reviews.name: Himanshu R
featured_reviews.review_text:
Friends I am music lover and also a performer. I want to inform you all that the oraganizers are very rude. Folks why I am saying this because during a performance the mic and the speaker stopped working. On my fourth performance in Kasa Kai Pune as a singer but previously I was played guitar for the last three times. Yesterday the organizer called me because I messaged in a group that please this time 12th August 2023 give us a good speaker and mic. The organizer said I will look in to this matter but you please do not come in this eventans also in the future events. He was so rude while talking to me. Please don't attend Kasa Kai they don't give respect.
Himanshu Ishan
Ishan.himanshu (Instagram handle)

featured_reviews.name: Jason Alphonso
featured_reviews.review_text: I had attended a screening at up in the air andheri for the f1 screening so there were 3 of us and we came in early at around 6 pm which was the actual time to come so we took our seat or place and front of us there were only one table where in there were only two people sitting and we could also see the screen so we were ok with that  then when the match started the staffs added more table ahead of the table of us which completely ruined the view first of all they could have added the tables before end right why they had to put the tables later and now people who came in late they got to sit in the front and the people at the back couldn't see any thing this is totally unfair and disappointed. I have no idea what the organizer were doing.They did get the list of people so according to that they could have arrange the seating arrangements but they didn't. I gave the feedback to kasa kai team but I don't think they gave the feedback or took necessary actions.

featured_reviews.name: Miheek Rao
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing atmosphere, lovely to see such talented people from all walks of life. The Kasa Kai Team is extremely warm, and supportive of new talent.
